component.name: KataTone
component.summary: Patch editor for the BOSS Katana 50 Gen 3

description.p: KataTone edits the patches of a BOSS Katana 50 Gen 3 amplifier over USB, keeps them in a library of livesets (.tsl files) and writes them back to the amp.
It also has an Analyzer that compares your tone with a reference recording and proposes EQ settings, and a guitar Tuner that checks intonation at the 12th fret.

Fix: the settings of the phaser, flanger, tremolo, vibrato and the other effects stored late in the patch (most of the MOD and FX list) were shown as 0 when a patch was read. Writing a patch that uses them to the amp stored them wrongly; both are fixed.
Writing a patch stores the live value of the parameter an expression pedal drives, so what is saved is what you hear.

Analyzer: play the reference (the chosen part) to a sound card with Play/Pause and a time slider, with the display following it. The controls are grouped and compact, and the display options are push buttons.
Every remaining checkbox is a push button that stays pressed. The noise suppressor sits on the amp's knob line. A delay card is lit only when its effect is switched on.
New METRONOME tab: a click track with tap tempo, beats per bar and subdivisions, played to a sound card, and controllable from a MIDI footswitch.

The Amp tab shows the signal chain: pick the chain and the positions of the Pedal FX, the EQs and the Send/Return, see the order, and click an effect to switch it off or cycle its colour. The AMP card now holds the cabinet resonance, master key and noise suppressor.
The Assign tab has a sub-tab for each effect, and the Delay, EQ and effect cards are laid out more compactly.

Knobs can be selected and stepped with the arrow keys (1 and 10), and their value typed by clicking the number. The pitch shifter shows its direct mix first. The two preview mute buttons are one toggle.

Slot names are read from the amp when it connects, and switching to a slot read before is instant. Saving to the library asks before overwriting a patch. The SYSTEM tab no longer fails when opened right after connecting.
Undo and redo in the patch editor, and backup and restore of the whole amp.
Compare a patch with the editor or the amp, search the library with tags and favourites, and play a liveset as a setlist from big buttons or a footswitch.
MIDI: ready-made profiles, and the last message shown with a shortcut to map it.
Tuner: more tunings (the bass strings were not heard before), a fine needle and a strobe. Analyzer: apply the proposed EQ to the editor.
The version is shown in the window and by --version.
Available as a Flatpak (the desktop GUI, with the amp over USB).
New Analyzer tools to match a tone to a recording, and a tuner that checks intonation.
